t: 大王子伊凡四世被加冕为全俄罗斯的沙皇.
te: Grand Prince Ivan IV is crowned as Tsar of all Russia.
dz: 大王子伊凡四世被加冕为全俄罗斯的沙皇.
de: Grand Prince Ivan IV is crowned as Tsar of all Russia.

t: 比戈德的叛乱,一个试图抵抗英国改革的武装叛乱,开始了.
te: Bigod's Rebellion, an armed insurrection attempting to resist the English Reformation, begins.
dz: 比戈德的叛乱,一个试图抵抗英国改革的武装叛乱,开始了.
de: Bigod's Rebellion, an armed insurrection attempting to resist the English Reformation, begins.

t: 圣马塞卢斯被洪水淹没,造成北海沿岸至少25,000人丧生.
te: Saint Marcellus's flood kills at least 25,000 people on the shores of the North Sea.
dz: 圣马塞卢斯被洪水淹没,造成北海沿岸至少25,000人丧生.
de: Saint Marcellus's flood kills at least 25,000 people on the shores of the North Sea.

t: 数十至数百名犹太人被基督教徒以"造成"黑死病"为罪名被活活烧死.
te: Dozens to hundreds of Jews were burned to death by Christians after being accused of causing the Black Death.
dz: 巴塞尔大屠杀:数十至数百名犹太人被基督教徒以"造成"黑死病"为罪名被活活烧死.
de: Basel Massacre: Dozens to hundreds of Jews were burned to death by Christians after being accused of causing the Black Death.

t: 爱德华一世允许他的母亲普罗旺斯的埃莉诺将犹太人驱逐出伍斯特、马尔伯勒、剑桥和格洛斯特等城镇。
te: Edward I permits his mother Eleanor of Provence to expel the Jews from the towns Worcester, Marlborough, Cambridge and …
dz: 爱德华一世允许他的母亲普罗旺斯的埃莉诺将犹太人驱逐出伍斯特、马尔伯勒、剑桥和格洛斯特等城镇。
de: Edward I permits his mother Eleanor of Provence to expel the Jews from the towns Worcester, Marlborough, Cambridge and Gloucester.

t: 纳布卢斯议会举行,确立了耶路撒冷十字军王国最早幸存的成文法.
te: The Council of Nablus is held, establishing the earliest surviving written laws of the Crusader Kingdom of Jerusalem.
dz: 十字军:纳布卢斯议会举行,确立了耶路撒冷十字军王国最早幸存的成文法.
de: Crusades: The Council of Nablus is held, establishing the earliest surviving written laws of the Crusader Kingdom of Jerusalem.

t: 埃米尔阿卜杜勒-阿尔-拉赫曼三世建立科尔多瓦的哈里发.
te: Emir Abd-ar-Rahman III establishes the Caliphate of Córdoba.
dz: 埃米尔阿卜杜勒-阿尔-拉赫曼三世建立科尔多瓦的哈里发.
de: Emir Abd-ar-Rahman III establishes the Caliphate of Córdoba.

t: 奥斯特罗哥特人由托蒂拉国王统治,在长期围困后通过贿赂伊索里亚守军来征服罗马.
te: The Ostrogoths, under King Totila, conquer Rome after a long siege, by bribing the Isaurian garrison.
dz: 奥斯特罗哥特人由托蒂拉国王统治,在长期围困后通过贿赂伊索里亚守军来征服罗马.
de: The Ostrogoths, under King Totila, conquer Rome after a long siege, by bribing the Isaurian garrison.

t: 西雅杰·克克将军征服了提卡尔,拓宽了特奥蒂瓦坎国王斯皮尔特罗沃克·欧尔的领地.
te: General Siyaj K'ak' conquers Tikal, enlarging the domain of King Spearthrower Owl of Teotihuacán.
dz: 西雅杰·克克将军征服了提卡尔,拓宽了特奥蒂瓦坎国王斯皮尔特罗沃克·欧尔的领地.
de: General Siyaj K'ak' conquers Tikal, enlarging the domain of King Spearthrower Owl of Teotihuacán.

t: 盖乌斯·尤利乌斯·凯撒·奥克塔维亚努斯被罗马元老院授予奥古斯都爵位,标志着罗马帝国的开始.
te: Gaius Julius Caesar Octavianus is granted the title Augustus by the Roman Senate, marking the beginning of the Roman Em…
dz: 盖乌斯·尤利乌斯·凯撒·奥克塔维亚努斯被罗马元老院授予奥古斯都爵位,标志着罗马帝国的开始.
de: Gaius Julius Caesar Octavianus is granted the title Augustus by the Roman Senate, marking the beginning of the Roman Empire.

t: 哈特谢普苏特于50岁时去世并被安葬于国王之谷.
te: Hatshepsut dies at the age of 50 and is buried in the Valley of the Kings.
dz: 哈特谢普苏特于50岁时去世并被安葬于国王之谷.
de: Hatshepsut dies at the age of 50 and is buried in the Valley of the Kings.
